function.name: get_air_quality
function.description: Retrieve real-time air quality and pollution data for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the air quality data for.

detail.description: If true, additional data like PM2.5, PM10, ozone levels, and pollution sources will be retrieved. the value is set to false to default.

historical.description: Optional date (in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format) to retrieve historical data.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "紐約市的空氣質量數據是什麼，包括今天、昨天和前天的額外數據，如PM2.5、PM10、臭氧水平和污染源？今天是2023年5月5日。" They want air quality data for New York City for today, yesterday, and day before yesterday, with details like PM2.5, PM10, ozone levels, pollution sources. We have a function get_air_quality. We need to call it with location "New York City" or "New York". Provide detail true. For historical dates: we need to provide historical param for each date? The function signature: location, detail?, historical?. It returns data for that date. So we need to call three times: for 2023-05-05, 2023-05-04, 2023-05-03. But the function only accepts one date at a time. We can call it thrice. The user wants all data. So we should call function thrice. Use location "New York City". detail true. historical "2023-05-05", "2023-05-04", "2023-05-03". Then combine results. We'll produce calls.
